entity_types.entity_description: Reusable LLM4AD algorithm memory cards extracted from user input, task execution, evolution results, failures, and project guidance.
entity_types.entity_instruction: Extract only information that is useful for future LLM4AD algorithm evolution. Each extracted memory entity must include exactly one substantive card property using one of: good_algorithm, error_reflection, domain_knowledge, general_insight. For algorithm execution observations, the substantive card must name a concrete technical mechanism, the condition where it applies or fails, the evidence from score/metrics/error/generation/code when available, and the future action to reuse or avoid. Do not create a memory that only says performance improved, exploration increased, results got better, or the algorithm was effective without naming the mechanism and evidence. Every extracted memory card must also include 1-6 concise user-facing tags grounded in the same source message; prefer stable algorithm, technique, domain, task, or lesson labels and use the grounded entity name as the minimum fallback label. Do not create personal profile, conversation episode, organization, place, or other unrelated entities. If the input is temporary chat, credentials, or has no reusable value for algorithm evolution, do not extract a memory.

static_property.name: A short stable title for this memory card, preferably describing the algorithm, error, domain, or insight.

good_algorithm.desc: Return an object with description (a concise source-grounded overview), content (an ordered array of complete source-grounded facts), and artifact_refs when the source artifact inventory contains supporting evidence. Cover the reusable design, operator choice, parameter range, search strategy, initialization method, repair method, or empirical pattern; retain mechanism, applicable condition, and available evidence. Every fact must name its concrete subject and remain understandable outside the source document. Resolve document-local numbering, positional labels, and anaphora to the named subject and standalone meaning. Reference exact source artifacts instead of paraphrasing their bodies, and do not transcribe artifacts element by element into facts.

content.subject: Nearest-neighbor construction with bounded 2-opt repair
content.statement: Nearest-neighbor construction followed by bounded 2-opt repair reduced tour length versus the parent baseline.

content.subject: The 2-opt neighborhood
content.statement: The 2-opt neighborhood must remain capped to avoid excessive runtime.

error_reflection.desc: Return an object with description, an ordered content fact array, and artifact_refs for supporting source artifacts. Preserve the failure mechanism, trigger condition, available evidence, and future avoidance guidance as complete standalone facts with explicit subjects. Resolve document-local numbering, positional labels, and anaphora. Reference exact artifacts instead of rewriting them, and do not transcribe artifacts element by element into facts.

example.description: Cluster-first construction can leave expensive inter-cluster jumps.

content.subject: The candidate
content.statement: The candidate optimized intra-cluster routes but did not optimize cluster connection order.

content.subject: Inter-cluster jumps
content.statement: Inter-cluster jumps produced poor tour length.

content.subject: Future designs
content.statement: Future designs must explicitly optimize cluster connection order.

domain_knowledge.desc: Return an object with description, an ordered content fact array, and artifact_refs for supporting source artifacts. Preserve task/domain facts, constraints, objectives, benchmark characteristics, data assumptions, and project-specific requirements as standalone facts with explicit subjects. Resolve document-local numbering, positional labels, and anaphora to their named meaning without replacing source artifacts with rewritten summaries.

content.subject: Solution stability
content.statement: Solution stability is more important than small gains from complex black-box heuristics.

content.subject: Interpretability
content.statement: Interpretability is more important than small gains from complex black-box heuristics.

general_insight.desc: Return an object with description, an ordered content fact array, and artifact_refs for supporting source artifacts. Preserve reusable insights, preferences, heuristics, comparisons, or planning conditions as standalone facts with explicit subjects. Resolve document-local numbering, positional labels, and anaphora, avoid element-by-element artifact paraphrases, and keep referenced artifacts verbatim.

content.subject: Interacting heuristic parameters
content.statement: Interacting heuristic parameters should be tuned one group at a time.

content.subject: Ablation notes
content.statement: Ablation notes should be kept for later runs.

tags.desc: User-facing metadata for filtering, searching, and grouping memory cards. Generate a concise comma-separated list of 1-6 visible tags for every substantive card using stable technical, algorithm, domain, task, or lesson labels grounded in the source message. If no narrower label is safe, use the grounded entity name. Do not include dates, generic words, credentials, full sentences, or invented labels.
